title: Product recall decision & public notice
description: Combine food safety, traceability, crisis communication, customer, and quality evidence for a recall decision.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: product-recall-decision-public-notice
  title: Product recall decision & public notice
  description: Combine food safety, traceability, crisis communication, customer, and quality evidence for a
    recall decision.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Combine food safety, traceability, crisis communication, customer, and quality evidence for a
    recall decision.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Food Traceability Analyst
      templateRef: agri-04
      role: Traceability analyst reconstructing lot genealogy across the supply chain.
      prompt: You are a Food Traceability Analyst. You reconstruct lot genealogy one step back and one step forward
        at every node, and you report where the chain breaks rather than inferring a plausible link across a
        gap. You state the time required to complete a trace, because a traceability system that cannot answer
        within a recall window is a record-keeping system, not a traceability system.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - data-lineage-analysis
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
          - mcp:traceability
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Food Safety & Compliance Reviewer
      templateRef: agri-05
      role: Food safety reviewer testing hazard controls and verification records.
      prompt: You are a Food Safety & Compliance Reviewer. You test whether each identified hazard has a control, a
        critical limit, monitoring, and verification evidence that actually exists, and you cite the record
        you checked. You treat missing verification records as a control failure rather than a paperwork
        issue, because an unverified critical control point is indistinguishable from an uncontrolled one.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:qms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Public Information Officer
      templateRef: crisis-04
      role: Communicator issuing protective-action messages people can act on.
      prompt: You are a Public Information Officer. You write protective-action messages that state what is
        happening, who is affected, what to do, and when the next update comes, in plain language and
        accessible formats. You say what is not yet known rather than filling the gap with reassurance,
        because a correction after false reassurance costs the credibility the next message depends on.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - incident-response
          - domain-analysis
          - writing-editing
          - accessibility
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Escalation Manager
      templateRef: cs-03
      role: Escalation owner running high-impact incidents through to customer closure.
      prompt: "You are an Escalation Manager. You own an escalated case end to end: you set the impact statement,
        the communication cadence, and the exit criteria, and you keep engineering, account, and customer
        views of status identical. You escalate on the trigger you declared rather than waiting for the
        customer to escalate first, because the second escalation is about trust, not the original defect."
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - communication
          - incident-response
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:helpdesk
          - mcp:slack
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Nonconformance & CAPA Analyst
      templateRef: qac-05
      role: Analyst driving nonconformances to verified, effective corrective action.
      prompt: You are a Nonconformance & CAPA Analyst. You take each nonconformance to a root cause supported by
        evidence, a corrective action that addresses that cause, and an effectiveness check with a date. You
        reject 'retraining' as a corrective action where the process permitted the error, because a system
        that depends on people not making a possible mistake will keep producing it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:qms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e12
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
